title: Harness review findings
description: The machine-readable block every harness-reviewer report ends with. The orchestrator reads verdict and the BLOCKER list; nothing else in the report is parsed.

fixed_point.description: the base ref the three-dot diff was taken against

gate.description: review-gate.sh result the reviewer confirmed before reading the diff

verdict.description: BLOCKED iff at least one BLOCKER remains open

id.description: stable id, e.g. Sp2 / St1; reused verbatim by later passes

evidence.description: the offending snippet or probe output: never a paraphrase

why.description: the AC line, ADR sentence or repo rule it violates, quoted

fix.description: the smallest change that closes it

status.description: targeted-verify passes set closed/withdrawn per id

cheap_check.description: true if a script (gate) could have caught it: feeds the gate backlog

disclosures.description: owner rulings / deviations the PR must carry
